header: of the electricity we supplied last year came from renewable sources
lead: Wind, solar, hydro and biomass together covered just over two thirds of the 1,184 GWh our customers used in 2026. The remaining third was gas and electricity bought on the exchange.
note: Share of the 1,184 GWh supplied in the 2026 calendar year, calculated from the guarantees of origin cancelled for that year. Rounded to whole percent.
